# Asendify Realty

> Asendify Realty is a Pune real estate brokerage that lists flats for rent and for sale in three localities only: Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar and Viman Nagar. It is part of Asendify (asendify.co). Enquiries and site visits are arranged on WhatsApp: +91 90960 82894.

## How it works
- Browse listings by locality, type (rent or buy) and BHK, sort by price or newest, then message on WhatsApp from any listing.
- Asendify Realty checks requirements against available inventory and arranges site visits.
- Brokerage is due only once the deal is confirmed.

## Brokerage (fees)
- Rentals: 3 months' rent, charged to both the landlord and the tenant.
- Sales/purchases: 2% of the sale value, charged to both the buyer and the seller.
- A 45% service fee is added on top of every fee paid to Asendify Realty.

## Everything included, by name (last updated 20 October 2026)
- Three localities only: Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar and Viman Nagar in Pune, nowhere else
- Flats for rent: rental listings in all three localities
- Flats for sale: resale listings in all three localities
- Listings verified in person: we stay in three localities so every listing can be checked in person
- Only available flats: flats that are no longer available are hidden from the listings
- Featured listings: a running set of what's live right now, on the home page
- All listings page: the full inventory in one place
- Rent or buy filter: show only rentals or only flats for sale
- BHK filter: filter by number of bedrooms
- Locality filter: filter by Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar or Viman Nagar
- Sort: by price, low to high or high to low, or newest first
- Locality pages: a page each for Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar and Viman Nagar
- Property pages: every flat has its own page with a description
- Photo gallery: tap a thumbnail to see each photo large
- Spec table: BHK, bathrooms, area in sqft and furnishing for every flat
- Amenities: listed for each flat, such as parking, lift, security and power backup
- Price on every listing: monthly rent or the total sale price, in rupees
- Brokerage on every listing: the brokerage for that flat, shown before you enquire
- WhatsApp from any listing: one tap opens WhatsApp with a message that names the flat for you
- WhatsApp button on every page: for general enquiries about any of the three localities
- Tell us what you need: share your budget, locality and timeline
- Shortlisting: we match you against live inventory
- Site visits: arranged for anything that fits
- Help for owners: landlords and sellers in the three localities can find a tenant or buyer through us
- Brokerage only on a confirmed deal: you pay brokerage only when the keys change hands
- Full list: https://realty.asendify.co/#included

## Who it's for
- For: tenants and buyers looking for a flat in Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar or Viman Nagar; landlords and sellers of flats in those three localities.
- Not for: properties anywhere else in Pune or elsewhere; anyone looking for a deal without brokerage.
